_about: Hand-picked borders scripts/generate_neighbors.py adds to the land borders it finds in world.geojson. Point countries have no outline, and simplification pulled a few borders apart, so those land borders are listed here; the rest are fixed links (a bridge or tunnel you can drive or take a train through). Each counts as a border: neighbours both ways, 0 km apart. Keep this list short and reviewed — every entry changes Travel answers.

links.note: San Marino is a point country, enclaved by Italy
Vatican City is a point country, enclaved by Italy
Golan line; simplification leaves the outlines 0.6 km apart
Johor–Singapore Causeway and the Second Link; Singapore is a point country
King Fahd Causeway; Bahrain is a point country
